I did not reach implementation. Here is what I established and why I am stopping.

## Why blocked

The packet is a four-leg journey (a)(c)(d)(e) plus an AppSpec, schema corrections and tests against an application no journey has ever driven. Reading the four legs' real surfaces out of the era source consumed most of the 35-minute budget; starting a calibrate→write→gate loop now would end with the watchdog stopping me mid-edit and no receipt filed. Nothing was written — the working tree is exactly as I found it.

## Findings that should go straight into the re-cut

**1. The work-view host tag is `work-view`, not `work-view-page`.** `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/.versionless/cache/angular-super-productivity-v2-13-15-baseline/app/src/app/pages/work-view/work-view-page.component.ts:30` declares `selector: 'work-view'`. `work-view-page` is only the *file* name, which is what the u20b assumption was built on — that fully explains its zero. Inside it, `.work-view-header` and `.task-list-wrapper` are `<header>`/`<div>` classes on the component's own template, so both readings are consistent: the host tag correction is `work-view`.

**2. Leg (a) has a behavioral subtlety the journey must anchor on.** The work view renders `<add-task-bar [isDoubleEnterMode]="true" [isAddToBottom]="true">`. `addTask()` (add-task-bar.component.ts:156) means: text + Enter adds the task and clears the input; a second Enter on the now-empty input only increments `doubleEnterCount` (the placeholder flips to the START string); a third Enter emits `done` → `startWork()`, which is what leaves planning mode. `isAddToBacklog` defaults to `false`, so the created task lands in today's `task-list`, not the backlog. The rendered title is a contenteditable `div.task-title` inside `task`.

**3. Leg (c) has two distinct anchors, and they are not equivalent.** The header control `main-header .play-btn` dispatches `ToggleStart` and flips its own icon `play_arrow`→`pause` off `taskService.currentTaskId$`. The per-task controls are different elements: `task .start-task-btn` (rendered only when `!isCurrent`) and a sibling pause button (only when `isCurrent`), both inside `.hover-controls`, plus `task .play-icon-indicator` which exists only while `isCurrent`. Tracked time renders at `task .time-wrapper .time .time-val`. The settled reaction to anchor on is the icon flip plus `play-icon-indicator` presence — not a timer.

**4. Leg (d) is three sub-legs and deserves its own unit.** There is exactly one seeded project (`FIRST_PROJECT`, id `DEFAULT`, `store/project.reducer.ts:120-126`), so a project *switch* first requires creating a second project through the side-nav `addProject()` dialog. Dark theme is not a global toggle: it is `project.theme.isDarkTheme` (`project.model.ts:53`), edited through the formly `config-section` on `/project-settings` (`saveProjectThemCfg`) and applied by `GlobalThemeService` through material-css-vars — so the rendered-style probe has to be taken after a dialog-driven form save. The keyboard defaults are at `src/app/features/config/default-global-config.const.ts:45` (`goToWorkView: 'w'`, `toggleBacklog: 'b'`, `addNewTask: 'Shift+A'`, `showHelp: '?'`); `w` or `b` are the cheap meaningful ones.

**5. Leg (e) is ready to build.** `witnessIndexedDbStringKeys(inventory, 'SUP', 'SUP_STORE')` already exists at `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/packages/cli/src/witness/playwright-host.ts:332` and matches the app's `DatabaseService` localforage naming. No refusal is expected on this app's stores.

**6. Tooling defect worth fixing on its own.** `/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless/packages/cli/src/witness/playwright-host.ts` contains a literal NUL byte at offset 11502, inside the key sort in `readWitnessIndexedDbKeys`:

```ts
keys.sort((left, right) =>
    `${left.kind}\0${left.key}`.localeCompare(`${right.kind}\0${right.key}`),
);
```

It is a raw `0x00`, not the escape sequence. Consequence: ripgrep and grep classify the whole file as binary and return **no matches at all** — silently. Any worker grepping for host mechanisms gets an empty result and concludes the mechanism does not exist. Replacing the raw byte with `\u0000` costs nothing and removes a trap that will keep costing every future unit.

## Suggested re-cut

Three units, not one: (a)+(e) together (task creation and reload persistence share the created task and the key census); (c) alone; (d) alone (dialog + formly save + shortcut). The AppSpec skeleton and the `work-view` host-tag correction belong in the first.
